cells.gaps: No source found says national staff maintain the system or the foreign contract has ended. Margins ID co-operates the new system under an eight-year build, co-operate and transfer contract from 2026 and manages GAM ID until handover (GMB-010, GMB-011). Semlex's claim of a completed handover of the old system (GMB-013) was dropped: officials say parts stayed under its control.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-08: Margins manages GAM ID under its partnership and will train immigration officials to run it later (GMB-010, GMB-011), but the immigration department's officers run enrolment as of 28 August 2026 (GMB-004), the newest fact, so the national authority still runs it day to day. Nothing says its own staff maintain and upgrade it.
